$comment: Starter recipe — bulk-import evidence-link junction notes from a CSV. Each row produces one (subject_concept, predicate, evidence_doc) triple. Generic over: any concept ontology (NIST 800-53 controls, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, CIS safeguards, ISO 27001 clauses, etc.) + any evidence-doc namespace (Evidence/, Audits/, Runbooks/, etc.). Reviewer + review_date + status + confidence are user_preserve so subsequent reviewer workflow (manual edits, review automation) is not clobbered on re-import. Predicate vocabulary is open string per Tier 1 schema (junction-note predicate is not in the STRM enum); recipe authors pick covers/evidences/attests/reviews/etc. per their workflow.
